current_generators.source: DetectRL-X Binary file models (deepseek-v3, gemini-2.5-flash, gpt-4o, qwen-max), verified live 2026-11-07

notes: human-non-native/esl slice CUT in v1.0.0: no licensed source in the resolved set labels ESL ground truth; resolving an ESL-labelled dataset (licence first) is a follow-up for the full U3 coordinator.
Per-slice n=50 meets the drift-signal minimum; n>=100 per slice is required before any human-FPR claim is attached to that slice, so v1.0.0 carries no human-FPR claim on any slice.

No 2026 source was found prescribing an exact probe-corpus size for AI-text detectors specifically; n=400 is judgement from statistical constraints (Wilson CI, n>=100 for 1% FPR), not a literature prescription.
Corpus items are disjoint by content hash from every row measured for a U1 validation record; verified overlap is zero.
Beemo (CC-BY-NC-4.0 carve-out) and DetectRL-X (non-commercial academic research only) items make this corpus non-redistributable; it lives in the local cache only, never in the repo.
The freeze guarantee is items_sha256: re-running this build from the manifest reproduces identical item hashes (created_at_utc records the build date and is the only field that changes).

ai-current-generator.filter: label == 1 and meta.lang == 'english'; quality floor >= 80 words and >= 20 letter-tokens
ai-current-generator.licence: Three-way conflict — GitHub README: Apache License 2.0 with use strictly restricted to non-commercial academic research purposes; Hugging Face card/API: MIT; ACL 2026 paper: use strictly restricted to noncommercial academic research purposes. The strictest reading (non-commercial academic research only) governs.

ai-humanized.filter: label == 1 and meta.attack == 'synonym' (lexical-evasion attack: machine text processed to look human); quality floor >= 80 words and >= 20 letter-tokens

ai-legacy-generator.filter: label == 1 (machine); every MAGE generator is 2022-or-earlier, newest gpt-3.5-turbo; quality floor >= 80 words and >= 20 letter-tokens
ai-legacy-generator.licence: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE file, repo metadata, HF tag); README badge asserts CC BY 4.0 — record both, attribute the authors

ai-paraphrased.filter: label == 1 and meta.attack == 'paraphrase'; quality floor >= 80 words and >= 20 letter-tokens

benign-transformed.filter: fresh MAGE validation rows (25 human + 25 machine, quality floor >= 80 words and >= 20 letter-tokens) with a deterministic benign transform applied (round-robin start offset, so the slice does not collapse onto one transform); transform and base hash recorded per item
benign-transformed.licence: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE file, repo metadata, HF tag); README badge asserts CC BY 4.0 — record both, attribute the authors

human-native.filter: label == 0 (human); quality floor >= 80 words and >= 20 letter-tokens
human-native.licence: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE file, repo metadata, HF tag); README badge asserts CC BY 4.0 — record both, attribute the authors

human-short.licence: MIT (card) with field-level carve-outs: prompts + human_output from No Robots are CC-BY-NC-4.0; model_output and LLM-edited versions follow the underlying LLM licences

mixed-origin.filter: label is None and meta.version == 'v4' (ai_sentence_ratio 0.5-0.55); quality floor >= 80 words and >= 20 letter-tokens
